questions.stem: What is the function of aerenchyma tissue in hydrophytes?

options.text: It absorbs minerals directly from the surrounding water
It strengthens the stem so the plant can grow above the water surface
It stores water to prevent the plant from drying out
It provides large air spaces that help gases reach submerged parts of the plant and aid buoyancy

questions.explanation: Aerenchyma is a tissue with large air spaces found in hydrophytes (aquatic plants). These air spaces allow oxygen and other gases to diffuse to parts of the plant that are submerged underwater, and also help the plant float by providing buoyancy.
